title: When semiclassical spectra follow curves—and when they fill area
exact_target: Determine whether semiclassical eigenvalues of analytic non-Hermitian operators lie near curves in the complex plane.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002493 (AIM-PHYSICS-0001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Non-Hermitian quantum mechanics and symplectic geometry, source item 1.1.

status_qualification: The original says appropriate phase space without fixing global domains, symbol classes or a topology/rate of clustering. A universal assertion for every analytic symbol and realization would add hypotheses or quantifiers absent from the source. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
